events.title: Evidence of a Bending Curve
events.description: A major release underdelivers against its own briefing, and – the stronger signal – the price of top-tier capability falls sharply rather than staying flat, which is what happens when the frontier stops moving and last year's ceiling becomes this year's commodity. It is disputed at once, and the dispute is not resolvable from outside the laboratories.

events.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
events.description: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion. Nothing that has not happened before, at a scale that is slightly harder to dismiss. **This is a precursor: it opens the Taiwan gate for the next 3 turns.**

portfolio.name: Emergency Sovereign Compute Mobilisation
portfolio.description: A binding directive to fast-track permitting, grid access, and state aid approval for EU-controlled AI compute facilities that commit to reserving at least 40% of capacity for public safety, resilience, and sovereign industrial use

portfolio.name: Municipal Resilience Backchannel Integration
portfolio.description: Establish a formal EU-level coordination framework to fund, secure, and scale the emergent municipal backchannel network, standardising interoperability, auditing model use, and integrating outputs into national emergency planning` — **in flight**
